* Anyone is allowed to play in the qualifier. 
* Qualifiers will be played '''asap in December 2022''', prior to the main event.

== Sign up ==
[https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfsZuiIPWGULZN0fPD5W3zqCZNv0B5_eMPbtCYeuFB_B-4yLA/viewform Sign-up for the qualifier here]

== Structure ==
Qualifier structure is dependent on how many teams sign up.
* 2 teams: No qualifiers.
* 3 teams: All play all. Bo5. Top 2 advance.
* 4 teams: Double Elimination. Bo5. Top 2 advance.
* 5 teams: Group of 5, all play all: Bo3. Top 2 advance.
* 6 teams: 2 groups 3 teams each. 2 group games. Bo5. 2 finals: #1 vs #2. Winner of finals advance.
* More than 6 teams: Under construction.
